# Fit-M8

> Fit-M8 matches people for sports activities, Tinder-style. Users build a profile with
> favorite sports, skill level, and location, then swipe to find nearby workout partners,
> training buddies, or teammates, and chat once matched.

Fit-M8 is a Progressive Web App (SvelteKit + Firebase). Most in-app screens (discover feed,
matches, chat, profile) require an authenticated user session and are not meaningful to crawl
or index as standalone content; the pages below are the public, crawlable surface of the site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fit-m8.app/): Landing page introducing Fit-M8 and its sign-up/login entry point.
- [Terms of Service](https://fit-m8.app/terms): Terms governing use of the Fit-M8 app.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fit-m8.app/privacy): How Fit-M8 collects, uses, and stores user data.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://fit-m8.app/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable URLs.
